name: cobol-invoke-method-name-case
body: ClassIndex.resolve_invoke matches method names (literal or word) and class names case-insensitively, like COBOL words, because SPEC is silent on method-name case; a dynamic (identifier) method name resolves to nothing. Limit: a compiler that treats method literals case-sensitively would resolve two methods differing only in case to one target. Upgrade if a vendor manual or GnuCOBOL rule makes method literals case-sensitive.
